What to change to make this look and behave like your own app, and what depends on the Movies model.

## What is generic and what is Movies-specific

| Part | Generic? | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `src/ui/*`, `src/poster/Poster.tsx`, `src/theme/tokens.css`, `src/styles.css` | Generic | Buttons, chips, dialog, avatar, generated posters, tokens. They depend only on `src/lib/hash.ts` and `src/lib/initials.ts`. |
| `src/graph/GraphView.tsx` | Generic | Takes nodes and links. |
| `src/forms/PersonPicker.tsx` | Mostly generic | A typeahead over one entity type; copy it for another. |
| `src/forms/model.ts` | Pattern is generic | `buildCreateInput` and `buildUpdateInput` show how to turn form state into nested mutation inputs and diffs; the fields are Movie-specific. |
| `src/lib/filters.ts`, `peopleFilters.ts` | Pattern is generic | URL-synced filters and `where`/`sort` builders; the filter set is Movie-specific. |
| `src/pages/*`, `src/search/*` | Movie-specific | Rename and rework per entity. |
| `src/graphql/generated/*` | Generated | Re-run `npm run codegen`. |

## Change the look

- **Colours, spacing, radii, shadows:** edit the custom properties in `src/theme/tokens.css`. `:root` is the dark theme and `:root[data-theme="light"]` the light one; keep both in step. Text and background pairs need enough contrast (4.5:1 for normal text).
- **Fonts:** Public Sans is loaded from `@fontsource-variable/public-sans` in `src/main.tsx`; swap the package and the `--font` token.
- **Layout and components:** all styles are in `src/styles.css`, grouped by area (header, inputs, cards, results, detail, forms, dialog).
- **Brand name:** the header text is in `src/App.tsx` (`Header`), the page title in `index.html`.

## Change the posters and avatars

Posters are generated from the title and first genre in `src/poster/Poster.tsx`. Edit `GENRE_HUE` for the genre colours and `posterStyle` for the gradients. To use real images instead, add an image URL field to the schema and render an `<img>` in `Poster` when it exists, falling back to the generated style.

## About Needle

The look is styled after Neo4j's Needle design system (Public Sans, blue and teal palette, dark and light themes), reimplemented in our own components. The colour values are **approximations that have not been checked against Needle's published tokens**; compare them with neo4j.design before presenting this as Needle. The app does **not** use the `@neo4j-ndl/*` packages: they are GPL-3.0 and this repo is Apache-2.0, so adding them would make the combined work GPL-3.0. Do not add them without changing this repo's licence.

## Point it at a different server

Set `VITE_GRAPHQL_URL` at **build time** (Docker build argument, or an env var for `vite`). It must be reachable from the browser. For local development: `VITE_GRAPHQL_URL=http://localhost:4000/graphql npm run dev`. The server's `CORS_ORIGIN` must include the web origin (the dev server uses `http://localhost:3000`).

## Adapt it to another dataset

The step-by-step version, with a worked example, is in the `grandstack` umbrella repo (`docs/build-your-own-app.md`). In short: change the server schema and seed, run `npm run codegen` here, and the compiler lists every place that used a field you removed. Then rename pages and components, rewrite the filters to your fields, and update the forms.
